exact_owner_findings: WROOT_NODE(:) is accepted node root-biomass inventory, not a derived cumulative fraction.
WRT_OLD=WRT-GRRT+DRRT and RD_OLD=RD-RR reconstruct previous accepted totals/depth.
GRRT is split into GRRT_OLDNOD and GRRT_NEWNOD; new-node growth depends on root-extension geometry.
Existing-node growth mixes proportional biomass allocation and positive actual extraction distribution with FGWRT.
Root death mixes proportional biomass removal and positive stress reduction distribution with FDWRT, subject to WRTMIN.
CUMDENS is derived by normalizing WROOT_NODE inventory; CUMDENS_TOP is then a consumer view.
LRV_NODE and oxygen root-density views are derived in finalize_wroot_node; SWLRVCONSTANT may override LRV but does not replace WROOT_NODE ownership.
